Full-Lifecycle Facility and Infrastructure Expertise

From hyperscale data centers to modern hospitality, educational, commercial, industrial and public sector facilities, TIC Solutions delivers building systems and technologies that allow you get the most out of your vertical infrastructure. TIC Solutions serves the entire lifecycle of facilities from planning and design through operation and decommissioning of facilities. With specialists in mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection (MEP-FP), building technology, and clean energy design, as well as non-destructive testing and asset management, you can rest assured that industry’s leading professionals are delivering facilities with the latest technological advancements that stand the test of time.
Your Partner in Smarter Building Solutions
We bring innovation, technology, and expertise together to help clients achieve resilient, high-performing infrastructure.

TIC Solutions serves diversified end markets that are essential to the communities where we live and work, including industrials, infrastructure, energy, midstream, and renewables.

TIC Solutions’ 11,000 technical professionals operate out of over 200 locations across North America and abroad to deliver comprehensive asset improvement, maintenance, and reliability solutions to meet your specific needs.
Lifecycle Solutions for Critical Assets​

From infrastructure and building systems design and commissioning to testing, inspection, and compliance, TIC Solutions supports the entire lifecycle of assets and infrastructure through comprehensive solutions for engineering design, advanced inspection and nondestructive testing (NDT), Rope Access Technician (RAT) mitigation services, materials engineering services, lab analysis and destructive testing, proprietary software, and drone-enabled geospatial analytics.
